Resolves #19087

`findUnresolvableImports` now judges its resolved-path identity arm on `path.relative(root, resolved)`, and `esmodules.mjs` passes its build root. An engine built in place inside a consumer's `node_modules/neo.mjs` — how `neomjs/pages` deploys — no longer flags every import in its own tree. Pages' `build-all` gets past `dist/esm` again. The specifier arm is unchanged, and the resolved arm still catches an engine reached below or beside the root.

Evidence: L3 (pages' own layout built locally, with a same-tree A/B) plus L2 unit arms with red-first and mutation controls → L3 required (AC-3 is a pages-layout receipt). The deploy itself is #19047 AC-4's.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI: `esmWorkspaceBuild.spec.mjs` › "an engine built inside node_modules/neo.mjs builds its own tree" — the real script exits 0, and the emitted module still carries the sibling import. Red on the old guard. |
| AC-2 | CI: `esmDistTransforms.spec.mjs` › "an in-place build still fails an import that names node_modules/neo.mjs" and "an engine named only after normalization is caught below and beside the root", with the existing workspace identity arms. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: pages `main@1847ca65`, engine packed from `526b65e0ee` plus this head's two guard files (no other non-test file differs) → `npm run build-all` exits 0 in 37 s. `dist/esm`: 3,503 modules, no guard report. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
- Red-first: against the old guard files, exactly the two in-place arms fail (2 failed, 75 passed). With the fix, all 77 pass.
- Mutation: deleting the resolved-path arm fails exactly the normalization arm (1 failed, 76 passed), which is why that arm stays.
- Same-tree A/B in pages' layout: the old guard exits 1 with 3,214 imports flagged; this head exits 0.
- agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs ran.
